text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gwooooh, I did it... I really did it...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the opponent is huge, I tore right
through 'em! How ya like that, Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh, my legs are...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I'm honestly not that okay...
but I knew what I was gettin' into.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, don't look down on me just 'cause I'm short.
I jumped up and snatched it right away,
the souvenir for my family...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Firmly held in Tamamo Cross's hands—was the
crown of Satsuki that she had leaped up to seize.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, so this is the Classic Triple Crown, huh?
The battle for position was out of this world.
With my frame, that was seriously rough on me...
choice_data_list: Sounds like there were others who had a rough time too.
Looks like other girls had a tough time as well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah, that guy is...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, guh... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. In a race this big,
standin' out really does work against ya, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No matter where she went, she was marked.
Even so, she never uttered a single complaint...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She isn't... just flashy.
She's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross took the initiative to approach Gold City, and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good work, City.
That was tough on both of us, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, those eyes... look like they haven't given up.
They're shining with a far fiercer glare than your hair."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Umamusume aren't defined by looks.
I think so too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And it's not about body size either.
There are Umamusume with tons of guts
locked inside, just like Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on winning... the Satsuki Sho,
Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. Just like me, you're a lot tougher
than you look.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Let's keep it up together from now on! Having a classmate like you gets my heart pounding with excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding, the two stared at each other
with burning eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through sheer grit and guts, Tamamo Cross
brilliantly seized the first jewel of the Classic Triple Crown.
